versions.content: The Software Component Template shall provide the ability to define naming conventions for public symbols Type: valid Description: The Software Component Template shall provide the ability to define naming conventions for public symbols. This especially includes requirement ids, module abbreviations, meta data and configuration symbols used in the document of a release Rationale: Avoid ambiguities and name clashes inside the specification. Provide a consistent uniform presentation of meta data to the reader of the specification. Allow automatic processing of specification elements Use Case: Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
